name: Bid Corporation Limited
summary: Bid Corporation Limited operates as a foodservice distributor in the United Kingdom, Australia, the Netherlands, Italy, Czech Republic, New Zealand, Belgium, South Africa, the People's Republic of China, Hong Kong, and internationally. The company engages in supplying frozen, ambient, and chilled products to caterers and foodservice businesses; fresh food to hospitality, institutional, catering, and retail sectors; premium ice cream and texture-modified meals for people with swallowing difficulties; and proteins, dairy, charcuterie, and specialty products to hotels, international restaurant groups, and fine-dining establishments.
